'''Stone Bricks''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from 2 × {{MCW|Stone Brick Slab}}) and an [[Oven]] recipe (from [[Mossy Stone Bricks]]). See {{MCW|Stone Bricks}} for everything else.
